answer.reason: Only Nahum 3:10 states something that happened to No (Thebes); the other verses are prophecies of judgment against Egypt.

clauses.quote: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity

doubts: Jeremiah 46:25 and Ezekiel 30:14-16 foretell punishment of No and are not cited, since they describe what was to come rather than what happened.
